messages:
sophie: Quick flag - customers reported quota weirdness after yesterday's routing tweak. Console shows project buckets dropping while customer says SA usage should be billed to a dedicated token. Can we confirm current enforcement order?
mark: AFAIK enforcement order is: 1) explicit quota_token header, 2) project header, 3) fallback org. We never surface SA-level enforcement even when `X-Effective-Identity` present.
yara: That ordering was chosen to preserve existing billing signals, but we've been getting product asks to let SAs own quota for multi-tenant projects.
vik: Operationally that's tricky. If we start enforcing by SA when present, dedicated customers could see different behavior vs project meters. Need a migration path.
sophie: Proposed pattern: pipeline emits twin metrics streams `quota.attribution.project` and `quota.attribution.identity` (namespaced identifiers). Quota service reads identity stream when feature flag `quota_prefer_identity`=true. Console keeps rendering project by default but offers an "Attribution mode" toggle in the Quotas page.
mark: Sounds reasonable. Two asks: 1) the metrics tag must include both origin_project and effective_identity for every request; 2) we need a reconciliation job that can retro-fit 7 days of SA-attributed usage for customers to preview impact.
yara: Agreed. UX: when the toggle is on show a small diff summary for each project: "Projected change: -3.4% project usage -> will be charged to SAs." Also add a per-project preview modal.
billing-bot: Note: Changing enforcement for live customers can trigger billing anomalies. Recommend pilot on sandbox and 5% of traffic.
vik: Implementation plan: I'll add a change to the router to always propagate effective identity as tag `eid` to telemetry, regardless of policy. Then the pipeline will dup events into both streams; quota service will read either stream based on flag.
mark: Add unit and integration tests: ensure when `quota_prefer_identity`=true and `eid` present, deduction happens from SA bucket. Also assert we emit metrics to both kafka topics.
sophie: Who owns reconciliation + customer preview?
yara: I can make a preview endpoint in console and a small export CSV. Need backend PR to expose projected deltas per project.
vik: I'll scope the router + telemetry changes (ETA 2d). Pipeline dup stream PR (ETA 1d after router). Quota service + flag + tests (ETA 2d after pipeline). Console preview + toggle (ETA 3d after backend). Pilot roll: 5% traffic -> sandbox -> Dedicated -> global.
mark: For safety add a safety net: if re-attribution delta > 5% for any customer during pilot, auto-disable `quota_prefer_identity` for that customer's projects and open a ticket.
sophie: Good. Also add an observability dashboard: side-by-side sparkline of project-attributed vs identity-attributed tokens with divergence alert.
yara: I'll mock the toggle and preview modal in figma and post screenshots.
billing-bot: Reminder: run reconciliation before enabling pilot so sales/customer-success can be notified if we expect >2% billing shift.
mark: I'll write the migration runbook (backfill options, customer comms, rollback steps).
vik: I'll also add an e2e test exercising rollout flag toggles so we can simulate immediate revert.
sophie: Owners assigned: vik (telemetry + router), mark (quota service + tests + runbook), yara (console + screenshot + preview API). Leaving thread open for PR links and the reconciliation CSV. Ping here when the first numbers land. :mag:
